Commentary.Commentary: So the score is not a big one but the wicket is a little slow. Pakistan will have to bat sensibly if they are to chase this down, whereas, the Windies will have to bowl well to defend it. An exciting second essay awaits.

Diana Baig is up for an interview. She says that she was happy with her first three overs but is disappointed with her last one. Mentions that she  was a bit nervous there but when she got the first wicket she felt better. Further says that she just focuses on bowling in the right areas. On her teams performance today she mentions that it was a team effort but they need to work on their fielding. On being asked about the target they will be chasing tonight she says that 124 is chaseable and she hopes that they cross the line.

Diana was brilliant to begin with for Pakistan! The spinners did a good job in the middle overs, both Nida and Amin picked up two each. However, they took some pounding towards the end which they won't be happy about.

A good finish for the Windies has seen them end with a competitive score! They got off to the worst of starts though as they were three down with not a lot of runs on the board. However, the stand between Campbelle and Taylor steadied the ship. The former stepped on the accelerator but perished just as she started to get going. Taylor though hung in there but she too fell 7 short of a half ton. The Windies still managed to get around 44 in the last 5 overs which could prove to be the difference.
Length ball outside off, Connell looks to go downtown but edges it towards backward point for a single. WEST INDIES FINISH WITH 124/7!
OUT! CLEANED UP! It is bowled on a length and middle, Fletcher walks way across the stumps to flick it but is beaten and Afy hears the sound of the ball hitting the stumps.
Short ball on off, Fletcher this time pulls it through mid-wicket and gets couple.
FOUR! Powerfully struck there by Fletcher. It is full and outside off, Fletcher throws the bat to it and gets it through point for a boundary.
Length ball on the pads, Nation misses the flick and the ball rolls to the leg side off the pads. The batswomen take a leg bye.
Length ball on off, nation punches it through  the off side and gets a couple as there is a wild throw from the fielder in the deep towards the keeper.
The batswoman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for two.
Afy Fletcher comes out next to bat.

OUT! Taylor holes out! Dar has the last laugh! Taylor once again comes down the track and this time looks to clear the mid-wicket fence. Does not get the distance and Diana pouches it just ahead of the ropes. Big wicket, can easily make a difference of at least 10 runs to the final total.
SIX! Taylor finally gets hold of one. She comes down the track and lofts it high and handsome over the long on fence. Windies would love a few more from their skipper.
Shorter and outside off, Taylor looks to go over covers but misses.
Shorter and around off, Taylor mistimes it towards covers.
Short of a length ball on off, punched through the off side for a single.
SIX! The skipper continues to fight the lone battle as she pulls this length ball on off over mid-wicket and gets a maximum. 100 comes up for West Indies.
Good length and outside off, nation plays it through covers for a single.
Chedean Nation is in to bat now.

OUT! LBW! Henry just contributes in single digits tonight. Anwer lands one on a length and around off and middle, Henry misses her flick to get hit on the pads. An appeal follows and the umpire gives it out. Henry has a chat with her skipper and they decide against the review. Replays later on show it to be umpire's call on hitting the stumps.
Length ball going down the leg side, Henry misses her flick and the umpire gives it as a wide.
Short of a length and around off, Taylor punches it through covers for a single.
Length and outside off, Henry slaps it through covers and gets a single.
Taylor misses out! This is very full and outside off, ST creams it hard but straight to covers.
DROPPED! Floated up on off, it is hit powerfully back towards the bowler. Amin gets two hands to it but can't hang on. It rolls towards long off for one.
On off, kept out.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for two.
On middle, kept out.
Chinelle Henry walks in to bat next.

OUT! Three reds and that is the end of the partnership! Much-needed breakthrough as the stand was really starting to flourish. Good use of the review. It is very full and Campbelle looks to play the reverse sweep. She  misses and is hit on the pads. An appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Pakistan review and it shows no bat to be involved. Hawk Eye shows three reds.
Review time! A huge shout for an LBW has been turned down but Pakistan review. Looks close if no bat involved.
Slower one outside off, this is guided towards point for one. Another big over.
FOUR! Up and over! On off and fuller in length. Campbelle lofts it over mid off and bags a boundary. She is going for it now. Into the 40s she moves.
One more single as this is pushed down to long off.
Outside off, it is hit uppishly but well short of long on for one.
SIX! Top edge but it goes all the way! Runs coming thick and fast now. On middle, Campbelle swings, it goes off the top edge and just clears the square leg fence.
Slower and outside off, Campbelle looks to cut but misses.
Diana Baig is back on!
One more single as SC flicks it through mid-wicket. A good over for the Windies. Probably the momentum changing one.
A single now as this is worked through square leg.
A full toss, it is swept through square leg for one.
SIX! Over the fence! First of the game! SC comes down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and whips it well over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They manage to come back for the second.
On middle, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Nida Dar is back on!
Short of a length ball on off, Campbelle defends it off the back foot.
Length ball on off, Taylor pushes it to the off side off the back foot for a single.
Length ball on off, Campbelle pushes it off the back foot towards the off side and rotates the strike.
Length ball outside off, Taylor cuts it but Diana Baig at backward point does well to restrict the batters to a single.
Full and outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Full and on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket.
A single to end! Short and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Comes down the track and strokes it to the right of the bowler. A dot as the bowler dives and stops it.
Looks to stroke it through the off side but gets an outside edge down towards third man for two.
Campbelle comes down the track and works it wide of long on for two.

NOT OUT! Campbelle is well in! This is floated up outside off, SC tries to defend but misses. The keeper collects it and whips the bails off. An appeal and the umpire takes it upstairs. Replays show that the batter is in.
A stumping appeal has been taken upstairs! The Pakistan players do not seem that excited.
Shorter and around off, this is cut towards point.
Short and outside off, Campbelle goes with hard hands on the drive and gets a thick outside edge towards third man for a single.
Short and wide outside off, Campbelle cuts it through point for another couple.
Short of a length ball on off, Campbelle punches it through covers and gets a couple.
Another ball on off, tapped to point and a run taken.

Good running and sloppy fielding. Riaz bowls one on off and Campbelle pushes it off the front foot towards covers. The fielder there takes the ball and goes for the direct hit but fails. A single is what results.
Length ball on off, driven straight to cover.
Full and on the pads, Campbelle drives it to long on and gets a run.
Flatter outside off, Taylor punches it to covers and gets a single.
Floated on  middle, Taylor sweeps it to square leg.
Floated outside off, Taylor lets it be.
Flatter and on off, Taylor cuts it to backward point.
FOUR! Slower through the air from Maroof. Width on offer too. Taylor smacks it through point and fetches a boundary.
Tossed up on off, driven through covers for a single.
Flatter on off, punched to covers.
Floated on off, driven to mid off.
Tossed up on off, Campbelle plays it to point and gets to the other end.
Flatter and outside off, Taylor pushes it to point and takes a run.
Full and fired in onto the pads, Taylor tucks it to the leg side and gets a couple.
One more single as this is pushed through covers for one.
Now brings out the sweep and hits it through square leg for one.
FOUR! Finds the gap this time! Welcome boundary for the Windies. Short and wide outside off, she missed out on the last ball but this time connects and hits it through point for a boundary.
Shorter and outside off, Taylor looks to cut but misses.
Campbelle uses her feet and strokes it back towards the bowler who makes a good stop.
Slower through the air and on middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
On off, it is pushed towards covers. Another good over for Pakistan.
The batter flicks it away with a wristy shot.
On middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Floats it up on off, this is eased through covers for one.
Angled into the pads, it is worked towards mid-wicket.
On the stumps, it is pushed to covers.
Down the leg side, Taylor looks to sweep but misses. Wided.
Anam Amin is back on. 10-0-10-0 so far from her.
This time Taylor finds the gap and strokes it through covers for one.
Shorter and outside off, Taylor cuts but to the fielder at point.
Campbelle uses her feet and eases it down to long on for one. She is off the mark.
Floats it up on off, this is hit back to the bowler.
Shemaine Campbelle comes in to bat now.

OUT! Straight down the throat of Iram! Windies in big trouble here. The pressure of the dots has got the better of Dottin. She looks to break free here. Good bowling from Dar as she tosses it up outside off. Dottin looks to go over long on but fails to get the desired elevation. Iram takes a good catch.
Slower through the air outside off, Dottin looks to play the paddle sweep but misses to get hit on the pads.
Nida Dar is on now!
A single to end the Powerplay! A good one for Pakistan. Windies are 28 for 2. Fuller and around middle, this is eased down to long on for one.
Another dot! Dottin is struggling to find the gaps! It is short again and around off, DD slaps it but straight to covers.
One more dot! Shorter and around off, this is pushed towards mid off.
Outside off, Dottin looks to go after it but ends up getting a bottom edge. It bounces and then lobs over the keeper. No run.
Back of a length and on off, Dottin pushes it towards covers.
Good length and on off, this is guided towards point for a single.
Length ball on off, Dottin blocks it off the full face of the bat. End of a Successful over from Diana Baig.

Another play and a miss! Length ball outside off, Dottin gets beaten on the bounce here as she looks to force this through the off side. The ball sneaks underneath the bat and goes on the bounce to the keeper.
PLAY AND A MISS! Length ball outside off, Dottin looks to go through the off side but fails to get anything behind that shot.
Fuller in length and outside off, Taylor runs it down to third man and gets to the other end.
On a good length and around off, Taylor plays it to mid off.
Deandra Dottin walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Diana Baig gets her second. What a start she has had. Baig bangs it in and keeps it outside off, the ball rears up onto Kirby who looks to hammer it over the off side. It takes the higher part and lobs towards cover-point where Muneeba Ali takes the easiest of the catches.
A single to end! Full and on middle, this is hit down to long on and a single is taken.
FOUR! Up and over! Full and wide outside off, Kirby carves it over covers for the second boundary in the over. This is turning out to be a good over for the Windies.
On off, kept out.
FOUR! Smashed! Length and around off, Kirby makes room and hammers it past mid off for a boundary.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Good length and on off, kept out
Aiman Anwer comes on now!

Dropped! A tough chance! A let off for Kirby! This is on middle. Kirby looks to whip it but it takes a top edge. It lobs as far as backward square leg. Fine leg runs in and dives forward to take it but can't hold on. Two taken by the batters.
One more length ball on off, this is guided towards point for a quick run. Good running.
Short and outside off, Taylor looks to cut but misses.
Shortish and just outside off, Taylor guides it to the man at point.
Good length and on off, Taylor guides it to point.
Down the leg side, this is flicked nicely but on the bounce to the fine leg fielder for one.
FOUR! Anam Amin goes short and wide, Taylor cuts it powerfully through point and gets a boundary. The West Indies skipper is in fine form.
Floated on off, Taylor keeps it out off the front foot towards covers.
Flatter and once again on the pads, Kirby looks to tuck it to the leg side but gets it off the pads  towards fine leg for a leg bye.
FOUR! Fuller and down the leg side, Kirby just helps it on its way to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Flatter and around off, Kirby looks to cut that but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Good fielding! Flatter and around off, this is pushed towards cover where the fielder dives to his left and makes a half stop. A single.
Anam Amin to bowl from the other end.
The batsman defends it from within the crease. A successful first over for Pakistan.
Windies are underway! On the pads, it is worked towards fine leg for one.
One more length delivery around middle, defended nicely.
On a length and around middle, kept out.
A full toss on middle, this is driven towards mid on.
Stafanie Taylor the West Indies skipper walks into bat very early than expected.

OUT! LBW! Matthews signals the 'T' but the time is up! She should have reviewed that immediately because it did seem to be pitching outside leg. Pakistan won't care though as this is a dream start for them in this World Cup. First game and a wicket off the first ball. It is an outswinger from Diana. It lands around leg. Matthews looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal and up goes the finger. Matthews quite casually walks up to her partner. She takes her own sweet time but then realizes time is running out, then she has a word with the non-striker and signals the 'T' but time is up. Hawk Eye indeed shows that it was pitching outside leg. That casual approach costs Matthews.

Done and dusted with the National Anthems. West Indies openers Hayley Matthews and Lee-Ann Kirby to start with the bat. The Pakistan players are also on the field and ready to kick start their World Cup campaign. Diana Baig to start with the ball for Pakistan.
Time for National Anthems as both teams line up for their respective ones. First it would be Pakistan's followed by West Indies'.
Pakistan Playing XI - Javeria Khan, Muneeba Ali, Bismah Maroof (c), Nida Dar, Umaima Sohail, Iram Javed, Aliya Riaz, Sidra Nawaz (wk), Aiman Anwer, Diana Baig, Anam Amin

West Indies Playing XI - Hayley Matthews, Lee-Ann Kirby, Stafanie Taylor (c), Deandra Dottin, Shemaine Campbelle (wk), Chedean Nation, Chinelle Henry, Shakera Selman ( In for Aaliyah Alleyne), Anisa Mohammed, Afy Fletcher, Shamilia Connell.

Pakistan skipper, Bismah Mahroof says she would have batted first too but now they will have to restrict them to a low total. States the last tour against the Windies gave them a lot of confidence and she hopes they can do well. Informs bowling is their strength and they would want to keep them to a low score.

West Indies skipper, Stafanie Taylor says they decided as a unit and made this decision. She hopes to put runs on the board now. Informs the dot ball percentage was high in the last game and rotation of strike will be important.
TOSS - It's time for the flip of the coin. It lands in favour of Stafanie Taylor. WEST INDIES BAT FIRST!

It is now time for the second game of today of the Women's World Cup. Pakistan will be taking on West Indies. This is Pakistan's first game and they will be eager to begin on a winning note. The WIndies on the other have head into this game on the back of a win against Thailand. They though will face a tougher test here. An exciting game awaits. Here we go...
